summary: Singularity Future Technology Ltd. filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its June 2025 securities purchase agreement with 18 investors. The amendment replaces existing warrants with amended and restated warrants exercisable at $0.001 per share, subject to shareholder approval. On August 12, 2026, the company issued 2,299,212 common shares (post 1:14 reverse split) in a Regulation S private placement, originally sold at $1.165 per unit for ~$30 million gross. The new warrants have not yet been issued. Watch for shareholder approval of the warrant amendment; this is a capital-raising and warrant repricing event, not a conventional special situation.
